err.k.ratelimit.title: API rate-limited (HTTP 429)
err.k.ratelimit.hint:
• Open "Settings → Keys / Providers" — check if any key was auto-disabled (429 / quota exhausted) and re-enable or add a new key.

• If the issue persists, switch to another available model / provider in Settings.
err.k.permission.title: Request rejected (HTTP 401/403: credential or model permission)
err.k.permission.hint:
• Expand the error details for the exact HTTP status and upstream reason. A 403 can be model-specific and does not by itself prove the key is permanently invalid.
• If other requests also keep failing, check Settings → Keys. If only this model fails, switch models or request model access.
err.k.no_slot.title: No available API key slot
err.k.no_slot.hint:
• Open "Settings → Keys / Providers" — check if any key was auto-disabled (429 / quota exhausted) and re-enable or add a new key.
• Or wait a few minutes for the API rate-limit window to reset, then retry.
• If the issue persists, switch to another available model / provider in Settings.
err.k.dispatch_exhausted.title: All keys for this model have been exhausted
err.k.dispatch_exhausted.hint:
• Open "Settings → Keys / Providers" — check if any key was auto-disabled (429 / quota exhausted) and re-enable or add a new key.
• Or wait a few minutes for the API rate-limit window to reset, then retry.
• If the issue persists, switch to another available model / provider in Settings.
err.k.timeout.title: Request timed out
err.k.timeout.hint: • Retry shortly. If timeouts persist, switch to a faster model in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.network.title: Network connection error
err.k.network.hint: • Check your network / proxy settings, then retry.
err.k.endpoint_unreachable.title: Model endpoint unreachable
err.k.endpoint_unreachable.hint:
• The model endpoint could not be reached (connection refused or timed out) — this can be a local proxy/network outage OR the self-hosted / BYO server being down, the port not listening, or a firewall blocking it.
• Check your network / proxy and retry; if the server is confirmed reachable, switch to another available model in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.content_filter.title: Response blocked by the model's safety filter
err.k.content_filter.hint: • Try rephrasing the question or switching to another model.
err.k.invalid_image.title: Image rejected by the API
err.k.invalid_image.hint: • Reduce image size or count and try again.
err.k.invalid_image.hintMany: • Too many large images. When sending 5+ images, each must be under 2000×2000 pixels. Please resize or remove some images.
err.k.invalid_image.hintSize: • One or more images in this conversation exceed the API size limit. Please use a smaller image or remove the oversized image.
err.k.prompt_too_long.title: Context exceeds the model's limit
err.k.prompt_too_long.hint: • Auto-compaction did not free enough room — trim the history or switch to a larger-context model.
err.k.stream_only.title: Model only supports streaming
err.k.stream_only.hint: • Switch to another model (this one is auto-excluded).
err.k.model_limit.title: Output exceeds model max_tokens
err.k.model_limit.hint: • The new limit has been recorded — retry.
err.k.tool_rounds_exhausted.title: Tool call round limit reached
err.k.tool_rounds_exhausted.hint: • The model did not finish within the per-task budget — click Continue to extend.
err.k.tool_timeout.title: Repeated tool-execution timeouts
err.k.tool_timeout.hint: • The tool keeps timing out — simplify the request or raise the tool-timeout in Settings.
err.k.tool_loop.title: Model stuck in a repeated tool-call loop
err.k.tool_loop.hint:
• The model repeatedly issued identical or semantically equivalent tool calls without obtaining new evidence. The system first sent one recovery instruction and stopped only after there was still no progress, preventing further wasted spend.
• Prefer Continue to resume from the latest checkpoint; use Retry if Continue is unavailable. If the same task keeps tripping this, rephrase / split the task, or switch models in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.premature_close.title: Gateway closed the stream prematurely
err.k.premature_close.hint: • Retries exhausted — the response may be incomplete. Click Retry to regenerate.
err.k.abnormal_stop.title: Stream ended without finish marker
err.k.abnormal_stop.hint: • The reply may be truncated. Click Retry to regenerate.
err.k.aborted.title: Stopped by user
err.k.server_offline.title: Server offline
err.k.server_offline.hint: • When the server comes back, this page will reconnect automatically and try to recover any content that was generated.
err.k.server_busy.title: Server is temporarily busy
err.k.server_busy.hint: • The server is temporarily out of capacity (active-task slots or memory headroom). Retry shortly; you do not need to change API keys or model settings.
err.k.task_start_failed.title: Generation executor did not start
err.k.task_start_failed.hint: • This request was settled safely and no background task is still running. Click Retry; if it recurs, check logs/error.log.
err.k.internal.title: Internal error
err.k.internal.hint: • Check the server logs (logs/error.log) for details.
err.k.generic.title: LLM call failed
err.k.generic.hint:
• Expand the error detail below for the underlying cause.
• If it recurs, check the server logs (logs/error.log) for the root cause; only if it proves to be a key/quota problem, go to "Settings → Keys / Providers".
err.k.bad_request.title: Request rejected by the API (HTTP 400)
err.k.bad_request.hint:
• This is NOT a key / quota / 429 problem — the API rejected the request payload itself. Expand the error detail below for the exact reason.
• If it recurs with no clear cause, check the server logs (logs/error.log).
err.k.not_found.title: Model or route not found upstream (HTTP 404)
err.k.not_found.hint:
• This is NOT a key / quota / 429 problem — the model or route does not exist on the upstream endpoint. Transient 404s on subscription channels are already retried automatically; a persistent one means the upstream is failing or the model was retired.
• Retry shortly; if it recurs, temporarily switch to another available model in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.content_refused.title: Translation rejected by quality check
err.k.content_refused.hint:
• The models repeatedly produced wrong-language / empty / runaway output; it was rejected and retried automatically. Retrying shortly usually lands a healthy model.
• If it recurs, switch the translation model in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.upstream_error.title: Upstream model service temporarily unavailable
err.k.upstream_error.hint:
• The model vendor or gateway is failing (not a problem with your API keys) — retrying shortly usually recovers.
• If it keeps failing for several minutes, temporarily switch to another available model in "Settings → Model defaults".
err.k.worker_lost.title: Task worker lost (no progress)
err.k.worker_lost.hint:
• The background worker produced no progress for too long and was declared dead — retrying the task is safe; partial output may have been lost.
• If it recurs, check the server logs (logs/error.log) to see whether the process was killed.
err.k.tool_not_available.title: Model called a tool that is not available this turn
err.k.tool_not_available.hint:
• This is NOT a key / quota problem — the model repeatedly called a tool that is **not in this turn's toolset**, so it never executed and the task stopped part-way. Expand the detail below for the exact tool name.
• Usually the capability is switched OFF for this conversation (e.g. code execution / browser / project tools). Enable it in the toolbar and retry, or tell the model to use a tool it actually has.
err.k.tool_call_rejected.title: Tool call was blocked before execution
err.k.tool_call_rejected.hint: • This is NOT a key / quota problem. A safety, authority, mode, approval, or argument check blocked the tool before it ran; expand the detail for the exact tool and reason.
err.k.budget_exceeded.title: Task stopped at a resource budget cap
err.k.budget_exceeded.hint:
• The task reached its configured cost, model-round, input-token, tool-output, or elapsed-time limit; generated content is preserved.
• To continue, inspect the specific limit in the error details and adjust that task budget.

brainWhy.peerStatus: Sibling conversations of this project that are running right now — used to avoid duplicating work already in progress.
brainWhy.boardRead: The shared to-do board across all conversations of this project — who is doing what, so work isn't duplicated.
brainWhy.boardMutate: Updates the shared to-do board so sibling conversations see this claim / change.
brainWhy.feedRead: A recent timeline of what other conversations of this project have been doing.
brainWhy.charterRead: The project's shared goal and committed decisions that every conversation aligns to.
brainWhy.charterPropose: Proposes a decision for the human to commit as shared project-wide intent — advisory until approved.
brainWhy.message: An advisory note to a sibling conversation, delivered on its next turn — it never interrupts a running turn.
brainWhy.intervene: Nudges a sibling conversation to re-check the board (advisory); a hard stop needs explicit human approval.
brainWhy.claimPath: Reserves specific files/paths on the shared board so sibling conversations hold off editing them while this conversation works — a durational, auto-expiring advisory lease, not a hard lock.
brainWhy.releasePath: Clears a previously-held file/path reservation so sibling conversations may edit those paths again.
brainWhy.commit: Commits ONLY the files this conversation provably authored (byte-identical to its own last edit); files also carrying a sibling's uncommitted changes are held back, never swept in.
brainWhy.listConvs: Searches your other conversations by title and content to find a relevant past discussion to reference.
